description: Enable file attachments on issues stored in Supabase Storage. Add Attachment interface and attachments array to Issue type. Add upload UI to IssueDetailModal (drag-drop zone + browse button, multi-file, 10 MB limit, progress indicator). Create server endpoints POST /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments (upload to Supabase Storage bucket 'issue-attachments', insert row into attachments table), DELETE /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments/:attachmentId (delete from storage + table), GET /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments (list). Display attachments in IssueDetailModal with download and delete actions (role-based: viewers read-only, members/admins/owners can upload and delete). Show attachment count badge on KanbanBoard cards. In localStorage fallback mode, store attachments as base64 data URIs (capped at 1 MB per file).
steps: 1. Add Attachment interface to src/types/index.ts (after Issue interface): { id: string; filename: string; size: number; mimeType: string; url: string; uploadedBy: User; uploadedAt: string }. Add attachments?: Attachment[] to the Issue interface.

2. Create migration SQL artifact at h:\vision for uniqtech\.agents\tasks\attachments-migration.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attachments (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(), issue_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES issues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, filename TEXT NOT NULL, size INTEGER NOT NULL, mime_type TEXT, storage_path TEXT NOT NULL, url TEXT, uploaded_by UUID REFERENCES users(id), uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_attachments_issue_id ON attachments(issue_id);
3. Install multer package for multipart uploads: npm install multer @types/multer --save

4. Add POST /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments endpoint in server.ts (after the comments endpoint, around line 1280). Use multer middleware to parse multipart/form-data. Validate file size <= 10 MB, accept images (png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp), PDF, text, code files (js, ts, py, etc.), Office docs (docx, xlsx, pptx). Upload to Supabase Storage bucket 'issue-attachments' with path {projectId}/{issueId}/{uuid}-{originalFilename}. Insert row into attachments table. Return attachment metadata.

5. Add DELETE /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments/:attachmentId endpoint in server.ts. Verify user has member/admin/owner role (not viewer). Fetch attachment row from attachments table, extract storage_path. Delete from Supabase Storage. Delete row from attachments table. Return success.
6. Add GET /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments endpoint in server.ts. Verify user has project access. Select from attachments table with uploaded_by user joined. Return array.

7. Modify IssueDetailModal.tsx: add an 'Attachments' section after the subtasks section (around line 350). Render a drag-and-drop zone (use <input type='file' multiple accept='image/*,application/pdf,text/*,.doc,.docx,.xls,.xlsx,.ppt,.pptx,.js,.ts,.py,.json,.xml,.yaml' hidden ref={fileInputRef} onChange={handleFileSelect} /> and a visible drop zone div with onDragOver, onDrop handlers). Add a 'Browse Files' button that triggers fileInputRef.current?.click(). On file selection, validate size <= 10 MB per file, show progress indicator, call POST /api/.../attachments with FormData. On success, fetch updated attachments list via GET. Display attached files: images as thumbnails (max 80px height), others as file-type icon + filename + size. Add download button (open URL in new tab) and delete button (only if userRole !== 'viewer' and current user is uploader or admin/owner).

8. Modify ProjectContext.tsx: in createIssue, set attachments: [] in newIssue. In updateIssue, if isSupabaseConfigured, fetch attachments via GET /api/.../attachments and merge into issue object before updating state.

9. Add attachment count badge to KanbanBoard.tsx renderCard function (around line 155): if issue.attachments && issue.attachments.length > 0, display a small badge with a paperclip icon and the count.

10. Implement localStorage fallback in ProjectContext.tsx: when uploading an attachment and !isSupabaseConfigured, read the file as base64 data URI (FileReader.readAsDataURL), check size <= 1 MB (smaller limit for localStorage), store in issue.attachments array in localStorage. When downloading, open data URI in new tab. When deleting, filter out from array.

11. Test end-to-end: upload an image to an issue, verify it appears in Supabase Storage and attachments table. Download the attachment. Delete it. Upload multiple files. Test role restrictions (viewer cannot upload/delete). Test localStorage fallback mode.
acceptance_criteria: attachments array added to Issue interface
Supabase attachments table created via migration SQL
multer package installed and used for file uploads

POST /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments endpoint accepts multipart/form-data, validates 10 MB limit, uploads to Supabase Storage 'issue-attachments' bucket, inserts row, returns metadata
DELETE /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments/:attachmentId endpoint deletes from storage and table (role-based: members/admins/owners only)
GET /api/projects/:projectId/issues/:issueId/attachments endpoint returns attachment list with user info
IssueDetailModal has drag-drop zone and browse button for uploads, displays attachments with thumbnails/icons, download and delete actions (role-based)
KanbanBoard shows attachment count badge (paperclip icon + count) on cards with attachments
localStorage fallback stores attachments as base64 data URIs (1 MB limit per file in fallback mode)
Failed uploads show inline error without crashing the modal
npm run lint passes with no TypeScript errors
verification: Run `npm run lint` and confirm zero errors
Run `npm run dev` and open http://localhost:5173
Open an issue detail modal, drag-and-drop a PNG image, confirm upload progress shows, confirm image appears as thumbnail
Click download button, confirm file opens in new tab
Click delete button (if allowed), confirm attachment is removed
Upload a 15 MB file, confirm error message appears
Upload a PDF and a .docx file, confirm they display with file-type icons
Open Supabase dashboard, verify files exist in 'issue-attachments' bucket and attachments table has rows
Test as viewer role, confirm upload and delete buttons are disabled or hidden
Stop dev server, clear VITE_SUPABASE_URL env var, restart, upload a small image, confirm localStorage base64 fallback works
